svg.text: Note: Inspect Manual for warranty information and specifics, also remember to use Plastic Spudgers to avoid damage.
Carefully remove keyboard from the top edge. Tilt it upward.
Identify snap-fit tabs or screws.Use a spudger to release clips.
Gently lift and flip the keyboard to expose the wiring.
HandlingRibbon CablesBE CAUTIOUS: Delicate ribbon cables are underneath.
Identify orange Backlight (small)& Blue Keystroke (large) cables.Slide out cables gently.
Replace with new FRU keyboard.Reconnect cables & secure clamps
Releasing the Keyboard Lifting and Flipping Disconnecting Cables
